cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam's is sharper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam's is sharper.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

cards.title: Give It Up

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The bakery can't sell your cake, love. They think it's too special to slice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says 'inedible.' I thought I'd finally found something I was good at.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You have. Display cakes aren't meant to be eaten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ask them to put it in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me ask. I'll explain the display concept before they get confused again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery can't sell your cake, love. They think it's too special to slice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says 'inedible.' I thought I'd finally found something I was good at.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have. Display cakes aren't meant to be eaten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ask them to put it in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me ask. I'll explain the display concept before they get confused again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The magazine hasn't rejected your poem. They think it deserves its own booklet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They returned it. If even you think it's hopeless, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why they returned it. They can't give it enough space.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you write that on the cover? With your name?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. 'A voice that deserves more space.' Print my name large enough for the editor to see.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?
